title: An isolated EmDash site on a host-networked tracy-host waits for its web port instead of being refused as a bridged host
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, run the isolated-fleet cases of the post-up suite: a stub whose loopback port refuses the first 13 dials and then answers (HOSTNAME is a machine name), and a stub whose port never answers.
expect: The first case ends with platform_post_up returning 0, no `docker inspect` of a tracy-host and no network connect (pre-fix: 'cannot identify this bridged tracy-host', return 1).
The second case returns nonzero with 'did not answer on 127.0.0.1:4321 within 90 s' and never says 'cannot identify this bridged'.
evidence: Measured 05/11/2026 on the dev host: two installs of tracy-restaurant/emdash-0.x failed ~15 s after the site network stage; after a restart of the web container the published port refused for ~1.5 s, then answered 200.
